description: This file defines the FrameDispatcher class which acts as an intermediary between the core Frame object and external channels, facilitating remote procedure calls. It handles navigation, querying, interaction, and evaluation methods specific to frames in a browser automation context, as part of the Playwright core implementation.

classes.name: FrameDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class bridging the core Frame object with external channels, managing frame interactions such as navigation, querying, and user interactions in a remote automations context.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the frame to a specified URL and returns the response.

methods.name: frameElement
methods.description: Retrieves the iframe element associated with the frame.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the context of the frame.

methods.name: evaluateExpressionHandle
methods.description: Evaluates an expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for a selector to appear in the frame.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a specified event on an element within the frame.

methods.name: evalOnSelector
methods.description: Evaluates an expression on a specific element matched by a selector.

methods.name: evalOnSelectorAll
methods.description: Evaluates an expression on all elements matched by a selector.

methods.name: querySelector
methods.description: Queries the frame for a specific element.

methods.name: querySelectorAll
methods.description: Queries all matching elements within the frame.

methods.name: queryCount
methods.description: Counts the number of elements matching a selector.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Retrieves the HTML content of the frame.

methods.name: click

methods.name: dragAndDrop

methods.name: innerHTML

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Gets an attribute value from an element.

methods.name: inputValue

methods.description: Waits for a specified timeout duration.

methods.name: expect
